description: This file defines the `PdfRubberStampAnnotation` class, a sealed class representing a rubber stamp annotation in a PDF document within the PDFsharp library. It includes constructors, a property for handling annotation icon types, and internal classes managing dictionary keys.

classes.name: PdfRubberStampAnnotation
classes.description: Represents a rubber stamp annotation with customizable icon within a PDF document.

classes.name: PdfRubberStampAnnotation.Keys
classes.description: Internal class defining dictionary keys specific to rubber stamp annotations, including the 'Name' key for icon selection.

methods.name: PdfRubberStampAnnotation
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new rubber stamp annotation.

methods.name: PdfRubberStampAnnotation
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new rubber stamp annotation associated with a specific PDF document.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the annotation by setting its subtype and default color.

methods.name: get Icon
methods.description: Gets the icon used for displaying the annotation, converting the stored name to an enum value.

methods.name: set Icon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the annotation by updating its dictionary key.
